title: Camera Intrinsics Profile
description: Per-camera lens intrinsics produced by Phase 2.5 chessboard calibration (cv2.calibrateCamera). Consumed by Phase 3 board calibration and by all pipeline stages that apply cv2.undistort(). See docs/CALIBRATION_SYSTEM.md and docs/DECISIONS.md D-023.

schemaVersion.description: Semver version of this schema. Current: 1.0.0.

cameraId.description: Matches the camera role identifier in cameras.yaml (e.g. 'cam_1', 'cam_2', 'cam_3').

resolution.description: Image resolution at which the intrinsics were calibrated. Intrinsics are invalid if the camera is operated at a different resolution.

cameraMatrix.description: 3x3 camera matrix K flattened in row-major order: [fx, 0, cx, 0, fy, cy, 0, 0, 1]. Units: pixels.

distortionCoefficients.description: 5-element distortion coefficient vector [k1, k2, p1, p2, k3] as returned by cv2.calibrateCamera.

meanReprojectionError.description: Mean reprojection error in pixels across all calibration frames. Must be < 0.5 px for the profile to be accepted by Phase 3.

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the intrinsics calibration was performed.
